knowledge_documents.title: Account locked - Standard Operating Procedure
knowledge_documents.content: Guidance for Account locked. Verify authenticated caller and tenant. Fetch authoritative structured state. Applicable evidence: account.status=locked, lock_reason, sign-in events. Actions must use approved tools only. For this case, the allowed workflow is unlock_own_account; verify account.status=active and new login simulation succeeds. When evidence is missing, create a ticket; never claim a fix without a successful verification.

knowledge_documents.content: Guidance for Forgot password. Verify authenticated caller and tenant. Fetch authoritative structured state. Applicable evidence: verified user identity, reset policy, account state. Actions must use approved tools only. For this case, the allowed workflow is issue_self_reset_challenge; verify reset challenge completed and credentials_version incremented. When evidence is missing, create a ticket; never claim a fix without a successful verification.
